column6: You’re the sole employee at the Kharnym Isle post office, stamping, sorting, and delivering mail. But the job hides secrets, and the office itself holds mysteries you must uncover. This will be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless you can escape.

Core Team:
**Harrison Wade**
Harrison is Letter Lost’s Founder and Composer. Harrison worked as a music director/pianist in New York City before moving to Minneapolis in 2014. He now helps run a theatre production company and fine arts center with his wife Christine.

**Jackson Wagner**
Jackson is our Lead Programmer and Designer. 
Beginning in 2019, Jackson worked as a Game Designer for the indie tactical-turned-based RPG, Wildermyth. 

**Bailey Wagner** 
Bailey is our Lead 2D Artist and Writer. She studied Video Game Development at St. Edward’s University before going on to work with the Wildermyth team as their social media manager.

column6: Classic EXTREME sports at their best: on ONE WHEEL! Perform unicycle stunts and combos with style, smash goals, unlock new levels, characters, cheats, and more! REAL uni pros, REAL uni tricks, REAL underground jams, and REAL retro play that begs for one more run!
column13: daffodil & friends is a studio encompassing video game developer daffodil, and their creative community of musicians, artists, sound designers, and everything in between. daffodil & friends embodies the projects spearheaded by daffodil which loop in connections to daffodil's interests, friends, peers, local neighbourhood, community members, and anyone who happens to step up to collaborating in any capacity on a given project. Basically daffodil & friends is the studio where stuff is made by daffodil and their friends.
